title: Add P1-6 supersession task in recovery plan (recoveryplan namespace) + status vocabulary dependency
objective: Enact the R0.5 commitment to record the frontend deferral as historical execution drift by adding a P1-6 task (in the recovery plan's namespace) that marks MVP plans as superseded, blocked by the new 'implemented-via-substitute' status vocabulary.

plan_assets.asset_description: Specification of the new recovery-plan task P1-6 with files, tier, verification, and blocker

scope: Edit Phase 1 (formerly R0) action-item table in dev/plans/recovery_plan_latex_contract.md to add a sixth row P1-6
Disambiguation: this is the recovery plan's P1-6 task slot, not this back2latex plan's P1-7 task itself
implementation_steps: Open dev/plans/recovery_plan_latex_contract.md and locate the Phase 1 (R0) action-item table
Append a new row with Task ID P1-6, Legacy ID 'R0.6 (new)'
Action item: 'Mark dev/plans/MVP_plan.md and dev/plans/MVP_sprint{1,2,3}.md as superseded by this recovery plan for the frontend contract; add a banner pointing here and an explicit superseded tag'
Files / surfaces: dev/plans/MVP_plan.md, dev/plans/MVP_sprint1.md, dev/plans/MVP_sprint2.md, dev/plans/MVP_sprint3.md
Blocked by: P1-4 (status vocabulary expansion must land first so 'implemented-via-substitute' is a legal value)
Verification: each superseded plan has a top banner; tracker rows for old P2.1..P2.5 carry 'implemented-via-substitute' status (not 'not_started')
deliverables: New row P1-6 in Phase 1 action-item table of dev/plans/recovery_plan_latex_contract.md
Row complete with all seven columns from amendment 3
acceptance_criteria: Phase 1 (R0) action-item table contains exactly six rows after this edit
P1-6 row has Tier=docs and Blocked by=P1-4
All four MVP plan files appear in the Files / surfaces column

cases: P1-6 row exists with the specified field values
Blocked-by reference to P1-4 is consistent with P1-3's table

risks: Naming collision is conceptually possible — P1-6 in recovery plan differs from P1-6 in back2latex plan; mitigated because each plan's tasks live in their own namespace (dev/tasks/<plan>/json/)
completion_notes: Appended P1-6 supersession row to Phase 1 action-item table; Tier=docs, Blocked by=P1-4, all four MVP plan files listed; test_p1_7 passes 3/3.
